user_saw: After choosing Favorites and closing the picker with an unstarred model selected, users saw the current model’s provider when they reopened it.
summary: The model picker now reopens on Favorites whenever it was the last tab chosen and is still available, even with an unstarred model selected.
reasoning: The commit that added Favorites tab memory explicitly tested that an unstarred selection reopened on its own provider, and the intervening Favorites reordering commit left that rule in place. The fix reverses that test expectation and documents the new reopening rule.
